meta.title: Gestioo – Management software for multisport clubs (Switzerland & France)
meta.description: Members, registrations, schedules, Swiss QR-bill, double-entry accounting and an AI assistant: one web tool to run your club without spreadsheets.

hero.eyebrow: For multisport clubs and associations – Switzerland & France
hero.title: Run your club in one place, without spreadsheets
hero.lead: Gestioo brings together members, registrations by season and team, the training schedule, membership invoicing with the Swiss QR-bill, double-entry accounting and communication with families – with a built-in AI assistant.

profiles.title: A solution for every role in the club
profiles.intro: Whether you volunteer on the committee, coach a team or are a parent, everyone quickly finds what they need.

items.before: spreadsheets, manual reminders, bank reconciliation by hand, a painful year-end close.
items.after: QR-bills generated and sent in bulk, reminders, camt bank statement import and reconciliation, automatic accounting entries, guided year-end close with balance sheet and income statement as PDF, tailor-made financial reports exported to Excel.

items.before: paper or email registrations, team lists scattered everywhere.
items.after: online registration by families, one-click approval, up-to-date teams and rosters, targeted group emails, custom lists and statistics exportable to CSV or Excel.

items.before: paper attendance sheets, a schedule shared over chat.
items.after: attendance taken on a smartphone, even without a network, a schedule by team and by hall, expense claims online.

items.before: no idea where their children's registration or payment stands.
items.after: the “My family” space: step-by-step registration, payment in 1 to 4 instalments, invoices, upcoming classes and club announcements.
a dashboard (active members, membership fees collected, balance to be received, pending tasks) and custom reports you can save and export to Excel.

items.title: Designed for Switzerland
items.text: Swiss QR-bill, camt bank statements, AHV number, Swiss double-entry accounting and an interface in French, German and English.

items.title: Accounting built in, not bolted on
items.text: Every invoice, payment, refund, expense claim or supplier invoice automatically feeds the general ledger.

items.title: Families at the centre
items.text: One account = one family, several members, payment in instalments.

items.title: Works offline
items.text: Attendance taking at the pitch side keeps working without a network and syncs when the connection returns.

items.title: Voice AI assistant
items.text: Ask a question or create a registration by speaking, with confirmation before any action.

items.title: Permissions by role
items.text: Everyone (administrator, committee, staff, member) only sees what concerns them.

items.title: Installable on your phone
items.text: No app store needed, and always up to date.

items.title: In your club's colours
items.text: Your association's logo, main colour and login image.

items.title: Custom reports, no spreadsheet
items.text: The committee builds its own lists and statistics (columns, filters, totals), exports them to Excel or PDF and saves them as reusable templates.

modules.title: Everything you need to run your club
modules.intro: An overview of the modules available today.

groups.title: Members and families
items: Complete member record, change history and internal comments
Active / inactive status, filters and search
“My family” space: step-by-step registration, required actions, upcoming classes over 7 days, announcements

groups.title: Seasons, teams and registrations
items: Configurable seasons, teams (colour, roster) and roles
Registrations validated by the committee, discounts and payment in instalments
Automatic emails when a registration is approved or cancelled

groups.title: Schedule and attendance
items: Halls, recurring time slots per team and holiday periods
Week and day schedule views in team colours
Attendance on a smartphone, even offline, with automatic sync

groups.title: Federation licences
items: Federations and licences per member
Licence paid by the club, invoiced to the member or paid directly by the member
Tracking of payments to the federation with an accounting entry

groups.title: Membership fees and invoicing
items: PDF invoices with Swiss QR-bill, sent by email with a sending history
Payment in 2, 3 or 4 instalments, single or bulk reminders
Payments, write-offs, overpayments refunded or applied to another invoice

groups.title: Swiss double-entry accounting
items: Configurable chart of accounts, manual and automatic entries
Live balance sheet and income statement, PDF export
Guided year-end close and bank reconciliation by camt import

groups.title: Expense claims and suppliers
items: Expense claims with receipts and an approval workflow
Suppliers, contacts and supplier invoices with attachments
Automatic accounting entries

groups.title: Communication
items: Announcements with priority and audience
Targeted group emails (season, team, age, role…) with history
Customisable email templates

groups.title: Dashboard and reports
items: Active members, fees collected, balance to be received, tasks to handle
Report builder over 9 data sources, as a list or grouped with totals
CSV, Excel and PDF export; private templates or templates shared with the committee

groups.title: Settings and access
items: Club name, logo, main colour and login image
Club rules: mandatory AHV number, self-service team choice, payment and reminder deadlines
Protected accounts: verified email, strong passwords, anti-bot protection

modules.notYetTitle: Good to know: not available yet
notYet: A native iOS/Android app (the web app can be installed on your phone)
Account creation by the administrator (accounts are created by self-registration)

assistant.title: An AI assistant that saves you time
assistant.lead: A conversational assistant is built into the application.
points: Search for members, seasons, teams, registrations, fees, invoices, users and report templates
Creation of a member, a season, a team, a registration or a payment
Navigation to the page of the application you are looking for
assistant.safety: The assistant respects your access rights and never creates anything without your explicit confirmation.
assistant.eyebrow: Powered by Mistral AI, a European AI

items.title: Access by role
items.text: Each user only sees and edits what their role allows; families only access their own data.

items.title: Protected accounts
items.text: Email verification, strong passwords, anti-bot protection (Cloudflare Turnstile) and secure sessions.

items.title: Tamper-proof accounting
items.text: A validated entry is locked; a correction goes through a traceable reversal; a closed financial year can no longer be modified.

items.title: Traceability
items.text: Change history of member records, history of emails and reminders sent per invoice.

items.title: AI under control
items.text: The assistant never creates anything without the user's explicit confirmation; European AI (Mistral AI).

items.title: Software quality
items.text: Every server feature is covered by automated tests.

items.title: Custom reports: CSV, Excel and PDF exports
items.text: The committee and administrators build lists and statistics over 9 data sources, export them as CSV, Excel or PDF, and save private or shared templates that can be exported in one click.

contact.title: Let's talk about your club
contact.text: A question, or want to see more? Write to us.

footer.text: Gestioo – web ERP for multisport associations in Switzerland and France.
